tools.name: smspva_docs_search
tools.description: Find guides, API methods and warnings in one language. Lexical search supports accented Spanish and Chinese words, prioritizes titles and avoids repeated code boilerplate. Returns page IDs, snippets and relative URLs; use read_page for complete context.

tools.name: smspva_docs_read_page
tools.description: Read Markdown for a page in the selected locale, including original parameters, codes and warnings. Follow next_offset until null for the complete page; offsets and max_chars count Unicode code points. No filesystem or external URL access.

tools.name: smspva_docs_get_examples
tools.description: Get verbatim fenced examples from a page, without running them. Filter by programming language and request/response/guide kind. Returns available_languages, source lines and pagination. No example translation, code execution or live request.

tools.name: smspva_docs_list_pages
tools.description: List page IDs, titles and descriptions in one language, optionally filtered by API family. Follow next_offset to browse all pages.
